rule.statement: The corpus has been duly identified when the preliminary plan has been prepared by physically surveying the land and the boundaries of the plan tally with the boundaries of the schedule to the plaint.
rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, it is my position that, as the said preliminary plan has been duly prepared by the Court Commissioner by physically surveying the land, and further, as the boundaries of the said preliminary plan tallies with the boundaries of the schedule to the plaint, the corpus has been duly identified.
